question.text: InvITs invest in infrastructure assets such as roads, bridges, ports, and airports. Under which SEBI regulation are they registered?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook page 282, InvITs invest in infrastructure projects such as roads, bridges, ports, and airports and are registered with SEBI under the SEBI (InvITs) Regulations, 2014. REITs are registered under the separate SEBI (REITs) Regulations, 2014 (page 277). The Trap: The AIF Regulations, 2012 are tempting because Category I AIFs include infrastructure funds, but InvITs are a distinct vehicle with their own 2014 regulation. The "SEBI (Infrastructure Funds) Regulations, 2016" option is a fabricated regulation. Note: REITs and InvITs are governed by separate SEBI regulations, both notified in 2014, but each is a self-contained framework for its respective asset class.
